purpose: Service review for WUP2025 rank 807 Calabar (city code 8459); city-local registry evidence and safe anonymous full-polygon access status.
registryBasis: Cross River State Ministry of Lands identifies the Land Department as custodian of land registration/title records and locates it in Calabar. The official CRGIA, based in Calabar, manages state land/geospatial information, surveying and C-of-O services; state budget materials also identify cadastral-survey work in Calabar Municipal. This is local office and city-area evidence, while the registry mandate covers the wider state.

officialSources.observation: Official Cross River Ministry of Lands says its Land Department maintains land records and is custodian of registration/title records across the State; its listed location is Calabar.

Official CRGIA describes state-wide land/geospatial data management, survey information, C-of-O processing and geospatial products; no anonymous parcel feature schema appears in the public landing page.
Official state yearbook map includes Calabar Municipal and Calabar South as distinct urban local-government areas.
Public agency portal landing page shows a username/password login form; no authentication was attempted.
